title: Create the Skies
description: Create the Skies is a mod pack for the create mod
body:
Take to the skies and build your own flying machines in this Create-focused adventure modpack centered around the power and creativity of Create Aeronautics and its addons.

Design massive airships, automated factories, and mechanical contraptions using the Create mod ecosystem, then set out to explore a world filled with new biomes, dangerous dungeons, hidden treasures, and exciting discoveries.

This modpack is built for players who love engineering, exploration, and progression. Build fully functional airships to travel across vast landscapes, uncover ancient structures, and conquer challenging encounters along the way.

Features
- Heavy focus on the Create mod and Create addon mods
- Build and customize functional airships with Create Aeronautics
- Explore beautiful new biomes and expansive world generation
- Discover dangerous dungeons, structures, and hidden loot
- Adventure-focused progression with rewarding exploration
- Extra quality-of-life and gameplay-enhancing mods included

Whether you want to become a sky pirate, a master engineer, or an explorer searching for lost treasures, this pack offers a unique blend of automation, creativity, and adventure.

Build. Fly. Explore.
